nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 storing token balances of accounts.
Nested mapping address => address => uint256 storing spending allowances.
Total token supply, reduced on burn.
Owner address controlled by Ownable, gates privileged functions.
Token name string, immutable after deployment.
Token symbol string, immutable after deployment.
Token decimals, set to 18 in constructor.
Public ERC20 transfer that moves tokens from msg.sender to recipient.
Public ERC20 transferFrom moving tokens using an allowance and decrementing it.
Public ERC20 approve granting spender an allowance from msg.sender.
Public helper that increases an existing allowance with SafeMath.add.
Public helper that decreases an existing allowance with SafeMath.sub.
Internal transfer routine performing balance subtraction and addition.
Internal burn routine reducing account balance and total supply.
Owner-only public burn that burns msg.sender's tokens.
Internal allowance writer emitting Approval.
OnlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0).
OnlyOwner function that transfers _owner to newOwner.
Contract constructor minting the entire supply to msg.sender.
Internal setter for the _decimals state variable.
Empty virtual hook invoked before every transfer or burn.
Public view returning the current _owner address.
Caller-controlled address used as sender, owner, spender and for ownership checks.
Balance subtraction and addition in _transfer using SafeMath sub/add.
Subtraction from _totalSupply inside _burn.
Subtraction of amount from allowance inside transferFrom.
Irreversible assignment of _owner to address(0) in renounceOwnership.
Privileged reassignment of _owner to newOwner address.
uint256 amount used by transfer, transferFrom, _transfer, _burn and burn.
address recipient receiving tokens in transfer and _transfer.
address spender granted allowance in approve/increase/decreaseAllowance.
address sender whose balance and allowance are debited.
address newOwner assigned to _owner in transferOwnership.
uint256 addedValue added to an existing allowance.
uint256 subtractedValue removed from an existing allowance.
Local address in the Ownable constructor holding _msgSender() result.
Local uint256 in SafeMath holding arithmetic results checked against overflow.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender argument into _transfer from transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner argument supplied to _approve in approve.
burn is restricted by onlyOwner and burns tokens of msg.sender, so caller identity is security critical.
renounceOwnership onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
transferOwnership onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender().
Context._msgSender returns msg.sender which is stored in the msgSender local variable.
amount parameter is forwarded into _transfer by transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded into _transfer by transfer.
amount drives the balance subtraction and addition inside _transfer.
sender indexes the _balances mapping debited arithmetically in _transfer.
recipient indexes the _balances mapping credited arithmetically in _transfer.
spender parameter is written into the _allowances mapping by _approve.
amount is subtracted from the allowance inside transferFrom.
sender parameter selects the allowance and balance touched in transferFrom.
spender selects the allowance entry increased in increaseAllowance.
addedValue is added to the allowance via SafeMath.add.
spender selects the allowance entry decreased in decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is subtracted from the allowance via SafeMath.sub.
newOwner flows into the privileged ownership reassignment path.
transfer delegates all state mutation to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom first calls _transfer to move tokens.
transferFrom then calls _approve to decrement the allowance.
approve delegates to the internal _approve writer.
increaseAllowance delegates to the internal _approve writer.
decreaseAllowance delegates to the internal _approve writer.
burn delegates to the internal _burn routine.
_transfer executes the balance subtraction and addition wrapped in SafeMath.
_burn executes the subtraction from _totalSupply.
transferFrom executes the subtraction of amount from the caller allowance.
renounceOwnership irreversibly assigns _owner to address(0).
transferOwnership reassigns _owner to the supplied newOwner.
_transfer writes debited and credited entries in the _balances mapping.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping entry.
constructor assigns the whole supply to _balances[msg.sender].
constructor computes and sets _totalSupply with exponent arithmetic.
constructor uses msg.sender as the initial holder of all tokens.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook with address(0).
SafeMath local variable c holds the intermediate sum/product that backs the balance arithmetic.
newOwner parameter is written into the _owner state variable.
constructor reads msg.sender to seed balances and ownership.
msg.sender is forwarded as the sender into _transfer when transfer is called.
msg.sender is written as allowance owner inside _approve.
_burn decreases the balance of the burned account.
transfer ultimately mutates the _balances mapping through _transfer.
transfer reads _msgSender for the sender argument on every call.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists as an argument of the transfer routines; it is fully represented by the arithmetic performed in _transfer and can be merged into it.
recipient is a pure call argument indexing the _balances credited entry inside _transfer and has no independent semantic identity.
spender is only used as an argument indexing the _allowances mapping written by _approve.
sender is only used as an argument indexing the debited _balances entry processed by _transfer.
newOwner only exists as the argument that transferOwnership assigns into the _owner state variable.
addedValue is a pure argument of the addition executed inside increaseAllowance and can be merged into it.
subtractedValue is a pure argument of the subtraction executed inside decreaseAllowance and can be merged into it.
msgSender is a local copy of _msgSender() used only within the Ownable constructor and can be merged into that constructor.
The SafeMath local c only carries the intermediate arithmetic result checked by the balance add/sub operation and can be merged into it.
